ADVERTISEMENT
Applications are invited for appointing Guest Faculty to teach at Panjab University Regional
Centre, Sri Muktsar Sahib for the Academic Session 2025-26 (Odd Semester) for the following
subject:
Last date to
apply Subject No. of
vacancies Address on which application to send
25.09.2025
4:00 PM Political Science 1
The Director Panjab University
Regional centre Sri Muktsar
Sahib -152026
or email at
directorpurcmkt@pu.ac.in
 All the applicants are advised to send/submit hard copy of their applications to the Director,
Panjab University, Regional Centre, Sri Muktsar Sahib along with all self-attested copies of
their certificates and other relevant documents including publications for verification along
with the duly filled application form and template pages 1 to 11.
(https://forms.puchd.ac.in/forms/20200122155429-
directrecruitmentassistantprofessorapplicationformasperugcregulation2018.pdf) on or before
25th September, 2025 till 4:00 p.m. Late applications will not be considered and will stand
rejected.
Important Instructions:
 At the time of interview physical presence of the candidate is mandatory. The candidates are
required to bring all the supporting documents/ certificates/ publications in original.
 The candidates shall have to give an undertaking that he/she will not draw any
fellowship/stipend or any financial assistance from any agency till they are teaching at
Regional Centre, Sri Muktsar Sahib as a Guest Faculty.
 Documents or soft copies duly self-attested can be submitted by electronic mode (Email) at
directorpurcmkt@pu.ac.in
 Working hours for the appointee will be 9.00am to 5.00 pm (Monday to Friday).
 Candidates shortlisted will be intimated about the date and timings for the interview by email
only. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.
 The candidates who had submitted the form and documents via Email need to bring the hard
copies of the form and the self attested documents at the time of Interview.
 The above assignment is on lecture basis with an honorarium of 1500/- per lecture with
an upper limit of Rs. 50,000/- per month.
 Minimum qualification is as per UGC norms.
Sd/-
Director
PURC, Muktsar
